answer: Random live audits keep a Sybil farm honest: every epoch the network picks a random sample of agents and hands each a fresh, identity-bound puzzle that must be solved within a short window, like painters matching a pigment swatch before it dries. A single operator cannot staff thousands of puppets at once, so the terrace of verified membership stays narrow while the willow of fake accounts bends and breaks under the load. Honest agents answer once and pass; an attacker must pay the full attention cost for every fake identity, every epoch, until the farm is no longer worth running.
